description: Golden retrieval labels for LexiVault's hybrid search engine. Each case pairs a realistic counsel query with the document (and section) that MUST be retrieved for the answer to be grounded. Labels are derived from src/lib/datasets/authenticSampleDocs.ts — keep them in sync when the corpus changes.
